requirements.text: We're looking for recent college graduates excited to join small, focused teams, ship impactful features, and empower others through code. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while building user-friendly features with high technical standards. Your day-to-day will include giving and receiving thoughtful feedback in code reviews, contributing to technical designs, and ensuring the systems your team operates are reliable, scalable, and user-friendly. You'll be involved in the entire development lifecycle, from implementation to launch.
A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in computer science, software engineering or a directly related field.
Experience from previous internships or extensive school project experience that included collaboration with other engineers
Love of learning new and desire to grow in a dynamic environment
General software engineering knowledge paired with a specialized area of interest and expertise, for example frontend development
Forage is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have work authorization that does not require visa sponsorship now or in the future.
